errors.evidence: The chart shows only one line representing a single data series. The model incorrectly interprets the change in marker style (from circles to stars) as indicating a second line.
The model hallucinates a 'blue solid line'. The single line in the chart is red and dashed throughout its entire length.
This phrase is used to describe the relationship between two fictitious lines. Since there is only one line, describing it as two overlapping lines is structurally incorrect.
